items.author: Steve Adams, hand-drawn wireframe to working Tableau Data App, Nov 11
items.summary: He sketched a dashboard by hand, gave it to Claude with one prompt, and got back a working Superstore data app (map, filters, sales/profit switch, light/dark mode), running as a local preview with Tableau Cloud next. 9 reactions, 8 comments.

items.author: Aedan Radvanyi, analytics dev lifecycle with Tableau Next Data Apps, Nov 13
items.summary: An analytics director walks through building with Data Apps using Slackbot as the developer, then lands on native Tableau Next dashboards plus a conversational overlay as the final deliverable. 12 reactions, 1 repost.

items.author: Angela Henderson, Tableau + Claude rebuild of her Jeopardy leaderboard, Nov 13
items.summary: Claude connected to a Tableau Cloud sandbox found the workbook, read fields and refreshed the data; the dashboard is live on Tableau Public, and Tableau Studio and Data Apps are next. 3 reactions, 1 comment.

items.author: Tableau (reshared by David Church), "Your first data app is just a conversation away," Nov 13
items.summary: Official Tableau video on building a first Data App conversationally.

items.author: Joan Sison, her BI tool timeline from 2013 to now, Nov 12
items.summary: A chart of her path through Yellowfin, Power BI, Tableau and now Claude live dashboards, arguing the dashboard layer is the most automatable part while the data and semantic-layer foundation is not. 314 reactions, 28 comments, 3 reposts.

items.author: Ethan Aaron, "pretty" AI data outputs now read as AI slop, Nov 11
items.summary: He's pivoting from AI-polished visuals to a governed narrative with a named, accountable human behind the numbers. 693 reactions, 52 comments, 15 reposts.

items.author: Isin Pesch, Anthropic's "Claude Data" BI tool and certified queries, Nov 13
items.summary: Claude Data turns on by default for Enterprise plans on Nov 19; she calls certified queries a semantic layer by another name and warns any editor can certify by default. 39 reactions, 7 comments, 4 reposts.
